scope: Proposition 6.1 (Ordered square-kernel estimate) of the manuscript “A power saving for square-difference-free sets” (preprints/A-power-saving-for-square-difference-free-sets-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 182 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5a8fe70cdef077a7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 28-29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let N ≥ 1 be an integer, put H = Nβ/2, and let D = 8d0 ≤ Nβ, where d0 is odd and squarefree. Suppose F, J : [N] → C satisfy |F|, |J| ≤ 1 and are supported in residue classes a, b modulo D, respectively. Assume that b − a is a strict square class, that x < y whenever x ∈ supp F and y ∈ supp J, and that no such difference y − x is the square of a positive integer. With b F(ξ) = 1 N N X n=1 F(n)e(−nξ), b J(ξ) = 1 N N X n=1 J(n)e(−nξ), one has D X ξ∈Q/Z: q(ξ)≤H q(ξ) squarefree, (q(ξ),D)=1 g(ξ) b F(−ξ) b J(ξ) ≪ H−1/3 . (6.3) 28 The implied constant is absolute and is independent of all the data in the statement.
